collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager finds a small carved bone earring lying beside the path.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) finds a small carved bone earring lying beside the path. (name1) asks around and returns it to its grateful owner.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) finds a small carved bone earring lying beside the path. The owner had been searching for days and hugs (name1).

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) finds a small carved bone earring lying beside the path. (name1) leaves it on a stone where its owner will see it.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) finds a small carved bone earring lying beside the path. Nobody claims it, so (name1) hangs it by the communal water jar for safekeeping.
